# Day Index

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The index note that links all artifacts for a given day.

**Also known as:** Day Hub, Day Note

## Scope note

Hub note connecting DayPlan, DayLog, DayJournal, DayReview, and related notes for one Day.
